items_flat.title_en: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Rosalind Research for trusted life-sciences access
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出受信任存取的生物學專用GPT-6 Rosalind Research
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s October 30 changelog and system-card addendum introduce GPT-6 Rosalind Research (gpt-6-rosalind), a biology/drug-discovery variant that uses the same weights as GPT-6 Astra with adjusted refusals. It is available only to approved organizations via trusted access in Work, Codex, and the API, not in general Chat.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 10月30日變更紀錄與系統卡附錄推出GPT-6 Rosalind Research（gpt-6-rosalind），採用與GPT-6 Astra相同權重但調整拒絕機制的生物學／藥物發現專用模型。僅限經核准機構透過受信任存取在Work、Codex與API使用，一般Chat不提供。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a configuration-and-access product rather than a new trained model, letting OpenAI serve dual-use biology research under tighter institutional controls while keeping the base Astra weights unchanged. Independent benchmarks and broader availability timelines remain unstated.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是配置與存取控管產品而非全新訓練模型，讓OpenAI在維持Astra基礎權重下，以更嚴格機構控管服務雙用途生物學研究。獨立基準與更廣泛開放時程尚未公布。
items_flat.quote: GPT-6 Rosalind Research brings GPT-6 reasoning capabilities to multistep life sciences research, with safeguards designed for biological work.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-6 Rosalind Research將GPT-6推理能力帶入多步驟生命科學研究，並配備專為生物工作設計的防護措施。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for 1-trillion-parameter Large 4
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), a multimodal MoE model with roughly 1 trillion total parameters (about 52 billion active), on or around October 29 under its ecosystem open-weight license. Company reports cite gains on Terminal-Bench and token efficiency versus prior checkpoints; weights are on Hugging Face and also available via its API.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral約於10月29日以生態系開放權重授權發布Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）開放權重，為約1兆總參數（約520億啟用）的多模態MoE模型。公司報告稱在Terminal-Bench與token效率上較先前檢查點有所提升；權重已上Hugging Face，並可透過其API使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the largest recent open-weight frontier-class release, improving access for organizations that prefer self-hosting. Reported benchmark gains are company-sourced and still trail closed frontier models on several agentic coding suites; long-term maintenance and license restrictions will determine real-world uptake.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是近期最大規模的開放權重前沿級發布，提升偏好自託管組織的存取。報告基準提升來自公司來源，在多項代理編碼套件上仍落後封閉前沿模型；長期維護與授權限制將決定實際採用。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic renames Max 20x to Ultra and removes five-hour limit for verified accounts
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic將Max 20x改名Ultra，並對驗證帳號取消五小時限制
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s help center documents that the $200 Max 20x plan is now called Ultra, with prices unchanged. Verified Ultra accounts no longer face the rolling five-hour usage cap; weekly limits and other constraints remain. The change appeared around October 30 and is reflected in current pricing and support pages.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic說明中心記載，200美元的Max 20x方案現改名Ultra，價格不變。已驗證的Ultra帳號不再受滾動五小時使用上限限制；每週上限與其他約束仍在。此變更約於10月30日出現，並反映在目前定價與支援頁面。
items_flat.analysis_en: Removing the short-cycle cap on the top consumer plan reduces friction for heavy Claude Code users without increasing total weekly allowance, while the verification step adds a light anti-abuse gate. It is a product-policy tweak rather than a capability expansion.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 取消最高消費者方案的短週期上限，降低重度Claude Code使用者摩擦，但不增加每週總用量；驗證步驟則增加輕量反濫用門檻。屬產品政策調整而非能力擴張。
items_flat.quote: Verified Ultra accounts don't have a five-hour limit.
items_flat.quote_zh: 已驗證的Ultra帳號沒有五小時限制。

links.label: Claude Help Center – What is the Ultra plan?

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind expands Gemini-powered PlanAssist to 12 more UK councils
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind將Gemini驅動的PlanAssist擴至另外12個英國議會
items_flat.summary_en: DeepMind’s October 31 blog post states that PlanAssist, built with Gemini, is moving from three pilot councils into a 12-month beta with 12 additional English local authorities (15 total). Early pilots cut householder application assessment time by up to 58 percent; officers retain final decision authority.
items_flat.summary_zh: DeepMind 10月31日部落格指出，以Gemini打造的PlanAssist正從三個試點議會進入12個月測試，新增12個英格蘭地方當局（共15個）。早期試點將住戶申請評估時間最多減少58%；官員仍保有最終決定權。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a practical government-deployment story rather than a model release, showing Gemini applied to high-volume administrative work with human oversight retained. The 58 percent figure covers selected assessment tasks in pilots; end-to-end decision-time savings and error rates across the larger set are still to be measured.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是實際政府部署案例而非模型發布，顯示Gemini應用於高量行政工作且保留人類監督。58%數字涵蓋試點中選定評估任務；更大範圍的端到端決策時間節省與錯誤率仍待衡量。
items_flat.quote: PlanAssist has shown it can cut the time planning officers spend assessing householder applications by up to 58%.
items_flat.quote_zh: PlanAssist已顯示可將規劃官員評估住戶申請的時間最多減少58%。

items_flat.title_en: xAI/SpaceXSI to enable default invisible text watermarks on Grok API from November 7
items_flat.title_zh: xAI/SpaceXSI自11月7日起對Grok API文字預設啟用隱形浮水印
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXSI developer documentation states that starting November 7, 2026, text outputs from grok-4.7, grok-4.6, grok-4.5, grok-4.3 and three grok-4.20 variants will carry an invisible statistical watermark by default on both Responses and Chat Completions APIs. Team admins can opt out per model after confirming a legal exception; the change is framed as EU AI Act compliance.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXSI開發者文件指出，自2026年11月7日起，grok-4.7、grok-4.6、grok-4.5、grok-4.3及三個grok-4.20變體的文字輸出，將在Responses與Chat Completions API上預設帶有隱形統計浮水印。團隊管理員可在確認法律例外後按模型退出；此變更以符合歐盟AI法案為框架。
items_flat.analysis_en: The watermark is a compliance mechanism that slightly shapes token selection without adding visible characters or changing length/speed claims. It affects API customers only for now and leaves consumer Grok surfaces untouched; how detectable or robust the mark is in practice is not independently quantified in the docs.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 浮水印是合規機制，透過輕微塑造token選擇實現，不添加可見字元，亦不宣稱改變長度或速度。目前僅影響API客戶，消費者端Grok介面不受影響；實務上可偵測性與穩健性在文件中未有獨立量化。
items_flat.quote: Starting November 7, 2026, responses from these models include a watermark. It's on by default, and you can opt out per model.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自2026年11月7日起，這些模型的回應將包含浮水印。預設開啟，您可按模型退出。

links.label: SpaceXSI / xAI Developer Docs – Output Watermarking

brief_en: Quiet day on major model launches. OpenAI ships trusted-access GPT-6 Rosalind for biology; Anthropic renames top plan Ultra and lifts its 5-hour limit for verified users; Google expands Gemini-powered PlanAssist to more UK councils; xAI enables default API text watermarks from Nov 7 for EU compliance. Mistral’s Large 4 open weights remain the latest major open release.
brief_zh: 今日大廠無旗艦模型發布。OpenAI推出受信任存取的生物學專用GPT-6 Rosalind；Anthropic將最高方案改名Ultra並對驗證帳號取消五小時限制；Google將Gemini驅動的PlanAssist擴至更多英國議會；xAI自11月7日起對API文字預設加入隱形浮水印以符合歐盟法規。Mistral Large 4開放權重仍是最新主要開源發布。
